d: Our jobs aren't just about responding to guest inquiries. Instead, we want to create experiences that are memorable, personalized, and meaningful. Our Guest Relations Officers take the initiative to build strong guest connections and deliver exceptional service throughout every stage of the guest journey. They are empowered to anticipate needs, resolve concerns, and create positive experiences that exceed expectations.

Whether welcoming guests, handling requests and concerns, coordinating with operational departments, managing guest feedback, or providing recommendations about hotel services and local attractions, the Guest Relations Officer plays a key role in enhancing guest satisfaction and loyalty. They serve as a trusted point of contact, ensuring every interaction reflects the highest standards of hospitality and professionalism.

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success: creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest Relations Officers are expected to be highly visible throughout the property, engaging with guests, responding to service needs, and collaborating with associates across departments. Performing these responsibilities successfully and consistently is critical to delivering outstanding guest experiences and supporting business goals every day.

The Luxury Collection Hotels & Resorts, with over 120 properties in more than 35 countries, offers the promise of authentic experiences that evoke lasting, treasured memories. Our more than 100 years of experience, beginning in 1906 under the Italian CIGA brand – a collection of Europe's most celebrated and iconic properties – serves as a solid foundation as we continuously evolve to exceed the desires of the luxury traveler.

From legendary palaces and remote retreats to timeless modern classics, each luxury hotel and resort is a unique and cherished expression of its locale – a portal to the destination’s cultural charms and treasures. If you are someone with an appreciation for evocative storytelling, a keen interest and passion for this destination's heritage, and a desire to deliver genuine, personalized, and anticipatory hospitality, then we invite you on our journey. In joining The Luxury Collection, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global team, and become the best version of you.

d: The Senior Network and Security Engineer will be responsible for designing, implementing, integrating, and troubleshooting enterprise network and security solutions across multi-vendor environments.

The role requires extensive hands-on technical expertise, experience delivering complex projects within a System Integrator (SI) environment, and the ability to develop network architectures, lead technical discussions, and ensure compliance with applicable Qatar cybersecurity standards.
Design, implement, configure, and troubleshoot enterprise network and security solutions across multi-vendor environments.
Work with Cisco, Palo Alto, Fortinet, F5, and Check Point technologies.
Develop High-Level Designs (HLD), Low-Level Designs (LLD), network architecture diagrams, and technical documentation.
Manage and troubleshoot routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, wireless networks, WAN, VPNs, and IP telephony.
Implement network segmentation, high availability, redundancy, and secure connectivity solutions.
Perform advanced network troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and packet analysis using Wireshark.
Lead customer discussions, technical presentations, workshops, solution deployments, and infrastructure migrations.
Manage technical escalations, system integration, project documentation, and knowledge transfer.
Provide technical guidance to engineering teams and coordinate with customers, vendors, and project stakeholders.
Ensure solutions align with industry best practices, customer requirements, and applicable Qatar cybersecurity standards.
12–16 years of professional experience in networking and security.
Proven experience working within a System Integrator (SI) environment.
Strong hands-on experience with enterprise networking and multiple security vendors.
Experience in network and security architecture, HLD/LLD development, implementation, and troubleshooting.
Strong knowledge of routing, switching, firewalls, VPNs, and network security technologies.
Experience with Palo Alto and Fortinet security solutions is highly desirable.
Excellent customer-facing, technical communication, and problem-solving skills.
Experience delivering projects in banking, transportation, public sector, or education is preferred.
CISSP or GIAC certification is an advantage.
